title: Spider-Man Leadership Strike Team
summary: This leadership build floods the board with cheap allies fetched by Make the Call for both thwarting schemes and chipping damage while Swinging Web Kick plus Sneak Attack and Lead from the Front finish villains. Economy comes from Maria Hill, Nick Fury, dual resources, Helicarrier, Quinjet and Power of Leadership so the ally engine never stalls. Web-Warrior links and Ready effects keep the plan flexible across the full game.
